items.question: Can equal fame through two dawns be considered fitting in this context?
premises: The subject is known by two dawns.
This recognition is presented as equal in both cases.
Such equal attribution is declared not fitting here.
items.inference: Equal attribution of fame to two dawns is therefore inappropriate in this instance.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the subject described as known by two dawns depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Being known equally by two dawns is indeed not fitting here in that way.
